bias_estimate.note: bias estimated on the bias role only; reported as a diagnostic, not applied as a deployed offset.

risk_coverage.rule: signal_present if top-10% accepted-region mean actual improvement > 0, better than the same-action random expectation, and >=3 of 4 safety scenes improve; it is not a deployment safety proof.

verdict.conclusion_limit: Both probes fitting poorly only means this probe/budget/representation did not fit; it does not prove the native module is broken. Good MLP fit would not prove the spatial convolutional native head is solved.

notes: probe_only diagnostic; not a native convolutional head result and not a full R2P score.
cache x is the scattered 50-d projection input; no spatial adjacency, so no image reshape/3x3 head.
y is already normalised by the verified cache-generation cost_scale; the raw-unit MAE multiplies by it.
scattered regions are not independent images; metrics are reported as-is without a significance claim.
